models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
Authenticated user accounts with email/password credentials and profile information.

This table serves as the primary identity store for the Todo application. Each user has a unique email address for login, a securely hashed password, and a display name for personalization. The table tracks authentication security through failed login attempt counting and account lockout timestamps.

Key features:
- Email-based authentication with unique constraint
- Bcrypt-hashed passwords (cost factor 12+)
- Account lockout after 5 consecutive failed attempts (15-minute lockout)
- Soft delete capability for account recovery
- Profile display name (defaults to email on registration)

Relationships:
- Has many {@link todo_app_user_sessions} for JWT session management
- Owns all todos in the Todos domain component

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the user account.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address used for authentication. Must be unique across all users. Stored in lowercase for case-insensitive comparison. Maximum length is 254 characters per RFC standards.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt-hashed password with cost factor 12 or higher. The original password must meet complexity requirements: 8-128 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's chosen display name for personalization within the application. Initialized to the email address upon registration. Must be between 1 and 50 characters and cannot be blank. Not required to be unique across users.

plainFields.name: failed_attempt_count
plainFields.description: Counter tracking consecutive failed login attempts. Account is locked after 5 failed attempts. Reset to 0 upon successful authentication.

plainFields.name: locked_until
plainFields.description: Timestamp indicating when the account lockout expires. Account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. Null when account is not locked.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Set automatically upon registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated. Updated automatically on any profile or credential changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft-deleted. Null for active accounts. Used for account recovery scenarios.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
User session tracking table for authentication and login auditing.

Each session record captures a single login event for a {@link todo_app_users} actor, storing connection metadata including IP address, requested URL, and HTTP referrer header. Sessions have a defined expiration time for security purposes.

Sessions are created during user authentication and referenced for audit trails and session management. Multiple active sessions may exist per user (e.g., logged in on multiple devices).

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who owns this session. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was created, captured at authentication time.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Full URL path including query parameters from the authentication request, used for tracking the login origin.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP Referer header value from the login request, indicating the source page that led to authentication. May be null if not provided by the client.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created, marking the moment of successful authentication.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires and is no longer valid. Always set to enforce session lifetime limits for security.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
Main todo entity storing user task information including title, description, dates, completion status, and soft delete flag.

Each todo is owned by exactly one user through the {@link todo_app_users} relationship, ensuring complete data isolation between users. Users can create, view, edit, complete, and delete their todos through dedicated API endpoints.

The soft delete pattern (is_deleted flag) allows users to move todos to trash and restore them, with permanent deletion removing both the todo and its associated edit history entries from {@link todo_app_todo_histories}.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the user who owns this todo. Each todo belongs to exactly one user, and users can only access their own todos. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The title of the todo. Required field with maximum length of 200 characters. Leading and trailing whitespace is trimmed before storage.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo. Maximum length of 5000 characters. Can be null if not provided. Formatting including line breaks and whitespace is preserved exactly as provided.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo. Stored as date only without time component. Can be null if not specified.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo. Stored as date only without time component. Can be null if not specified. No validation constraint with start_date - start_date can be after due_date.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo. Binary state: true for complete, false for incomplete. New todos default to incomplete (false). Toggling completion status does not create edit history entries.

plainFields.name: is_deleted
plainFields.description: Soft delete flag for trash functionality. When true, the todo is in the trash and excluded from normal todo list queries. When false, the todo is active and visible in the normal list. Deleting a todo sets this to true without removing data.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was created. Set automatically on creation and immutable thereafter.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo was last modified. Updated automatically on any edit to title, description, start_date, due_date, is_completed, or is_deleted.

models.description:
Edit history entries tracking all modifications to todos.

Each history entry captures the state changes made during a todo edit operation. Records the timestamp of the edit and the new values for any changed fields (title, description, start_date, due_date). Fields that were not modified during an edit are stored as null to clearly distinguish between "not changed" and "changed to empty".

History entries are automatically created whenever a user edits their todo. Entries are sorted from most recent to oldest for display. When a todo is permanently deleted, all associated history entries are cascade deleted to maintain referential integrity.

This table supports the audit trail functionality, allowing users to review the complete modification history of their todos.

foreignFields.description: The todo that this history entry belongs to. References {@link todo_app_todos.id}. When the parent todo is permanently deleted, this history entry is cascade deleted.
foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id

models.name: todo_app_todo_histories

plainFields.description: The new title value after the edit. Null indicates the title was not modified during this edit operation.
plainFields.name: title

plainFields.description: The new description value after the edit. Null indicates the description was not modified during this edit operation.
plainFields.name: description

plainFields.description: The new start date value after the edit. Null indicates the start date was not modified during this edit operation.
plainFields.name: start_date

plainFields.description: The new due date value after the edit. Null indicates the due date was not modified during this edit operation.
plainFields.name: due_date

plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history entry was created, representing when the edit operation occurred. Used for sorting history entries from most recent to oldest.
plainFields.name: created_at
